settings.LlmGuide:
BEGINNER'S GUIDE:
- You start in Làng Tone. Follow the main quests of the village chief Tajima in order: they teach the basics, give rewards and unlock new maps. When unsure, choose the quest.
- Without a weapon you cannot fight: Tajima gives a wooden sword.
- Shops open after quest 3 (NV diệt sên trừ cóc). Kiriko sells HP/MP potions, Tabemono food. Carry potions before long hunts.
- Monsters drop yen (about one kill in ten) and sometimes items; drops are owner-only for 30 seconds, then public until they expire.
- Train on monsters from your level to about 3 levels above. Far stronger ones kill you; ones 10 levels below give no experience.
- At level 10, after quest 8 (visit the 3 schools), join your school: Hirosaki (kiếm, phi tiêu), Ookaza (kunai, cung) or Haruna (đao, quạt). Then read the school's book and use its weapon.
- Potential and skill points are spent for you. When a quest step needs a level, hunt until you reach it.
- If you die you return to the village with full HP; learn from it and avoid that monster for a while.
